english: The salted fish is looking pretty good...
french: Ce poisson séché et salé a l'air particulièrement appétissant...
russian: Солёная рыбка выглядит аппетитно...
bulgarian: The salted fish is looking pretty good...

english: It's so hot, it makes winter feel like summer!
french: Il est si épicé que même en plein hiver, tu as l'impression d'être en été !
russian: Он очень острый! Согревает так, что зима кажется летом!
bulgarian: It's so hot, it makes winter feel like summer!

english: I've got almost everything on my list! Ryis was asking after my barnburner curry.
french: J'ai presque tout ce qui était sur ma liste ! Ryis veut que je lui prépare mon curry spécial.
russian: Почти всё из списка куплено! Риз просил мой жгучий карри.
bulgarian: I've got almost everything on my list! Ryis was asking after my barnburner curry.

english: A few hours at the Bathhouse puts the spring back in my step!
french: Quelques heures aux bains, et me voilà requinqué !
russian: Пара часов в купальне — и я снова бодр как огурчик!
bulgarian: A few hours at the Bathhouse puts the spring back in my step!

english: Nice of you to check in!
french: C'est gentil à toi de prendre des nouvelles !
russian:
Как мило, что ты

заглянули

заглянулазаглянулзаглянуло!
bulgarian: Nice of you to check in!

english: The bathhouse is the cure for what ails me.
french: Les bains me soulagent énormément de la douleur.
russian: Купальня — лучшее лекарство от всех недугов.
bulgarian: The bathhouse is the cure for what ails me.

english: These days, my aches and pains keep me up.
french: En ce moment, j'ai du mal à dormir à cause de mes rhumatismes.
russian: В последнее время боль и ломота не дают покоя.
bulgarian: These days, my aches and pains keep me up.

english: Oh boy. I nearly fell asleep in the bath. It's just so cozy in there!
french: Oh là là, j'ai failli m'endormir dans le bain. On se sent si bien, ici !
russian: Ох, едва не уснул в купальне. Там так уютно!
bulgarian: Oh boy. I nearly fell asleep in the bath. It's just so cozy in there!

english: And I'm not just saying that because I helped build it.
french: Et je ne dis pas cela seulement parce que j'ai participé à sa construction.
russian: И я не потому это говорю, что сам помогал строить.
bulgarian: And I'm not just saying that because I helped build it.

english: This is a beautiful building!
french: Quel magnifique bâtiment !
russian: Какое красивое здание!
bulgarian: This is a beautiful building!

english: Probably because I built the house, hah!
french: C'est peut-être parce que c'est moi qui ai construit l'endroit, ha ha.
russian: Наверное, потому что я построил это заведение, ха!
bulgarian: Probably because I built the house, hah!

english: Hemlock always treats me to a second round on the house.
french: Hemlock m'offre toujours une deuxième tournée.
russian: Хемлок всегда угощает меня вторым стаканом за счёт заведения.
bulgarian: Hemlock always treats me to a second round on the house.

english: [Ari], hey! You checking in on me? You're a thoughtful one.
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Tu viens prendre de mes nouvelles ? Quelle délicate attention !
russian:
[Ari], привет! Навестить

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло? Ты очень

заботливые

заботливазаботливзаботливое.
bulgarian: [Ari], hey! You checking in on me? You're a thoughtful one.

english: Hmm... wonder if we're running low on oak... I should check our cedar stock too...
french: Mmm... Il ne doit plus nous rester beaucoup de bois de chêne... Et je devrais aussi jeter un œil à nos réserves de cèdre...
russian: Хм... не заканчивается ли у нас дуб? Надо и запасы кедра проверить...
bulgarian: Hmm... wonder if we're running low on oak... I should check our cedar stock too...

english: All this music makes me want to cut a rug!
french: Toute cette musique me donne envie de me trémousser !
russian: Вся эта музыка так и тянет пуститься в пляс!
bulgarian: All this music makes me want to cut a rug!

english: But I ended up just walking around! There's so many interesting things here!
french: En fait, je déambule depuis tout à l'heure ! Il y a tellement de choses intéressantes à voir, ici !
russian: А в итоге просто гуляю! Тут столько всего интересного!
bulgarian: But I ended up just walking around! There's so many interesting things here!

english: Ryis and I built some of the displays for the Museum, so I came down here to see how they were looking.
french: Comme Ryis et moi avons construit certaines des vitrines du musée, j'étais venu voir ce qu'elles donnaient une fois installées.
russian: Мы с Ризом собирали некоторые экспонаты для музея, вот я и пришёл посмотреть, как они выглядят.
bulgarian: Ryis and I built some of the displays for the Museum, so I came down here to see how they were looking.

english: Think I might turn in early tonight! My pillow is callin' me!
french: Je pense que je ne vais pas faire long feu, ce soir. L'appel de l'oreiller est plus fort que tout !
russian: Думаю, сегодня лягу пораньше! Подушка меня зовёт!
bulgarian: Think I might turn in early tonight! My pillow is callin' me!

english: Errol and I love to have a nice chat by the fountain... When we were younger, a couple of old timers always hogged it. Now it's our turn!
french: Errol et moi aimons bien discuter près de la fontaine... Dans le temps, il y avait toujours deux petits vieux qui la monopolisaient. C'est notre tour !
russian: Мы с Эрролом любим поболтать у фонтана... Раньше там всё время сидели старички. Теперь очередь за нами!
bulgarian: Errol and I love to have a nice chat by the fountain... When we were younger, a couple of old timers always hogged it. Now it's our turn!

english: I might've given him a run for his money in my prime, though!
french: Il faut dire que je ne l'ai pas ménagé, quand il était plus jeune !
russian: Хотя в молодости я бы ему фору дал!
bulgarian: I might've given him a run for his money in my prime, though!

english: My nephew works hard and has a good eye for detail. Better than mine, I'd say.
french: Mon neveu travaille dur et il est très minutieux. Plus que moi, à vrai dire.
russian: Мой племянник — трудяга, и глаз у него цепкий. Лучше, чем у меня, честно говоря.
bulgarian: My nephew works hard and has a good eye for detail. Better than mine, I'd say.

english: It's always good to host friends on a rainy day, eh? Lights the whole world up!
french: Comme il est bon d'avoir des amis autour de soi, en une journée pluvieuse ! C'est comme un rayon de soleil !
russian: В дождливый день всегда приятно принимать друзей, правда? Сразу всё вокруг теплее становится!
bulgarian: It's always good to host friends on a rainy day, eh? Lights the whole world up!

english: Morning, [Ari]! It's a gorgeous Sunday, make the most of it! I will too.
french: Bien le bonjour, [Ari] ! Quel beau dimanche, profites-en bien ! Moi, c'est ce que je vais faire.
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari]! Сегодня чудесное воскресенье — наслаждайся! Я тоже буду.
bulgarian: Morning, [Ari]! It's a gorgeous Sunday, make the most of it! I will too.

english: My nephew, Ryis, is around your age. He's taken the lead at the $Carpenter's Shop$ since I retired.
french: Ryis, mon neveu, a à peu près ton âge. Il a pris la tête de la $menuiserie$ à mon départ en retraite.
russian: Моему племяннику Ризу примерно столько же лет, сколько и тебе. Он главный в $столярной мастерской$ с тех пор, как я ушёл на пенсию.
bulgarian: My nephew, Ryis, is around your age. He's taken the lead at the $Carpenter's Shop$ since I retired.

english: We sell everything from $Crafting Stations$ and $Furniture Recipes$ to $Farm Buildings$ and $Home Upgrades$. Stop by anytime!
french: On y vend de tout, aussi bien des $établis$ et des $plans de mobilier$ que des $bâtiments de ferme$ et des $améliorations pour la maison$. Passe quand tu veux !
russian: Мы продаём всё: от $ремесленных станков$ и $чертежей мебели$ до $хозпостроек$ и $улучшений дома$. Заходи в любое время!
bulgarian: We sell everything from $Crafting Stations$ and $Furniture Recipes$ to $Farm Buildings$ and $Home Upgrades$. Stop by anytime!

english: Hi there! The name's Landen. You must be the one Lady Adeline was telling us about.
french: Salut ! Je m'appelle Landen. C'est sûrement toi dont dame Adeline nous a parlé !
russian:
Привет! Меня зовут Ланден. Ты, должно быть,

те самые

та самаятот самыйто самое, про кого леди Аделина нам рассказывала!
bulgarian: Hi there! The name's Landen. You must be the one Lady Adeline was telling us about.

english: Let me know if you need a hand with anything!
french: Si tu as besoin d'un coup de main, n'hésite pas à demander.
russian: Если что-то нужно — только скажи!
bulgarian: Let me know if you need a hand with anything!

english: Some days, these bones sure do feel it. But that's what a hot meal's for!
french: Certains jours, je ressens vraiment le poids des années. Heureusement, un bon repas chaud et il n'y paraît plus !
russian: Бывает, что кости прямо ноют. Но тут поможет горячая еда!
bulgarian: Some days, these bones sure do feel it. But that's what a hot meal's for!

english: Can you believe that they just find this stuff in the ground? Amazing!
french: Tu sais que tout cela provient du sol ? C'est incroyable !
russian: Ты только представь: ведь это всё просто находят в земле! Уму непостижимо!
bulgarian: Can you believe that they just find this stuff in the ground? Amazing!

english: Reminds me of... well, me!
french: Tu me fais penser... à moi !
russian: Прямо как я когда-то!
bulgarian: Reminds me of... well, me!

english: I know the word for you, [Ari]! It's industrious, that's what you are.
french: J'ai trouvé le mot qui convient parfaitement pour te décrire, [Ari]. Tu es très appliqué<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they>.
russian:
Я знаю, какое слово тебе подойдёт, [Ari]!

Трудолюбивые

ТрудолюбиваяТрудолюбивыйТрудолюбивое — вот кто ты!
bulgarian: I know the word for you, [Ari]! It's industrious, that's what you are.

english: I wonder what's the special at the Inn... maybe Reina's making =Vegetable Pot Pie=...
french: Je me demande quel est le plat du jour à l'auberge... Peut-être que Reina a préparé de la =tourte aux légumes=...
russian: Интересно, что сегодня в трактире на обед... может, Рейна готовит =овощной пирог=...
bulgarian: I wonder what's the special at the Inn... maybe Reina's making =Vegetable Pot Pie=...

english: Just kidding! I'm retired, haha!
french: Je plaisante ! Je suis à la retraite, ha ha ha !
russian: Шучу! Я ж на пенсии, ха-ха!
bulgarian: Just kidding! I'm retired, haha!

english: Gotta get ready for the long work week ahead of me...
french: Je dois me préparer pour une longue semaine de travail...
russian: Надо бы приготовиться к долгой рабочей неделе...
bulgarian: Gotta get ready for the long work week ahead of me...

english: Good supplies have been harder to come by since the earthquake. Glad we've got Lady Adeline's support.
french: Il est difficile d'obtenir des ressources de bonne qualité, depuis le tremblement de terre. Heureusement que nous pouvons compter sur l'aide de dame Adeline.
russian: С хорошими поставками после землетрясения стало туго. Хорошо, что у нас есть поддержка леди Аделины.
bulgarian: Good supplies have been harder to come by since the earthquake. Glad we've got Lady Adeline's support.

english: Can't be too careful with lumber, it'll wander off if you don't keep a sharp eye on it!
french: Il faut toujours faire attention au bois de construction qui traîne... On peut facilement tré-bûcher dessus !
russian: С лесоматериалами нужно быть начеку: отвернёшься — и уплывут!
bulgarian: Can't be too careful with lumber, it'll wander off if you don't keep a sharp eye on it!

english: Ryis is working on site today, so I'm manning the fort. I'm proud of my nephew, he's taken to this job with serious grit.
french: Ryis travaille sur un chantier aujourd'hui, alors je tiens la boutique. Je suis très fier de mon neveu, il prend son travail très au sérieux.
russian: Риз сегодня работает на объекте, а я за главного. Горжусь племянником: он в эту работу с головой ушёл.
bulgarian: Ryis is working on site today, so I'm manning the fort. I'm proud of my nephew, he's taken to this job with serious grit.

english: The manor garden's even prettier in winter! How's that work?
french: Les jardins du manoir sont encore plus jolis l'hiver. Comment est-ce possible ?
russian: Сад особняка зимой даже красивее! Как такое возможно?
bulgarian: The manor garden's even prettier in winter! How's that work?

english: The snow makes the manor garden look like a whole new place!
french: Les jardins du manoir sont complètement différents sous la neige !
russian: Снег так преображает сад особняка — будто совсем другое место!
bulgarian: The snow makes the manor garden look like a whole new place!

english: It's a winter wonderland out here!
french: Quel endroit féérique en hiver !
russian: Прямо зимняя сказка!
bulgarian: It's a winter wonderland out here!

english: Ahhh... love to feel those aches melt away...
french: Aaah... Je sens mes douleurs disparaître...
russian: А-а-а... люблю, когда боль уходит без следа...
bulgarian: Ahhh... love to feel those aches melt away...

english: Thank you.
french: Merci.
russian: Спасибо тебе.
bulgarian: Thank you.

english: You know [Ari], they say it's harder to make friends as you get older, but you made it easy breezy.
french: Tu sais, [Ari], on dit qu'avec l'âge il est plus difficile de se faire des amis, mais c'est un jeu d'enfant avec toi.
russian: Знаешь, [Ari], говорят, с возрастом друзей заводить труднее, но с тобой всё оказалось легко и просто.
bulgarian: You know [Ari], they say it's harder to make friends as you get older, but you made it easy breezy.

english: Ahh, listen to that pattering rain on the roof! Like music you could dance to!
french: Ah, que j'aime entendre la pluie qui tombe sur le toit. C'est comme une douce mélodie qui me donne envie de danser !
russian: Ах, послушай, как дождик стучит по крыше! Музыка, под которую хочется танцевать!
bulgarian: Ahh, listen to that pattering rain on the roof! Like music you could dance to!

english: Good to see you [Ari]! Customers rarely make it out here on rainy days... what can I help you with?
french: Quel plaisir de te voir, [Ari] ! Les clients se font rares les jours de pluie... Que puis-je faire pour toi ?
russian: Рад тебя видеть, [Ari]! В дождь клиенты сюда редко добираются... Чем могу помочь?
bulgarian: Good to see you [Ari]! Customers rarely make it out here on rainy days... what can I help you with?

english: Hey [Ari]! Take it one day at a time! You'll be staring down retirement before you know it!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! À chaque jour suffit sa peine. Tu prendras ta retraite bien assez vite !
russian: Эй, [Ari]! Живи одним днём! А там и до пенсии рукой подать!
bulgarian: Hey [Ari]! Take it one day at a time! You'll be staring down retirement before you know it!

english: Nothing beats a little woodworking under the open sky!
french: J'aime beaucoup travailler le bois à l'extérieur !
russian: Нет ничего лучше плотницкой работы под открытым небом!
bulgarian: Nothing beats a little woodworking under the open sky!

english: Love that fresh air. So good. [Ari], are you getting enough fresh air?
french: Un grand bol d'air pur, il n'y a que ça de vrai. Tu t'aères suffisamment la tête, [Ari] ?
russian: Свежий воздух — просто чудо. [Ari], ты им тоже наслаждаешься?
bulgarian: Love that fresh air. So good. [Ari], are you getting enough fresh air?

english: Oh, wait. It feels great! Yeah!
french: Et par indescriptible, je veux dire merveilleux ! Ça, oui !
russian: Ой, подожди. Это просто великолепно! Точно!
bulgarian: Oh, wait. It feels great! Yeah!

english: It's hard to describe the feeling of waking up in a house you built with your own two hands.
french: Ce que l'on ressent en se réveillant dans une maison que l'on a construite de ses propres mains est indescriptible.
russian: Трудно описать, каково это: просыпаться в доме, построенном своими руками.
bulgarian: It's hard to describe the feeling of waking up in a house you built with your own two hands.

english: Lot of memories on this road. Errol and I used to race just over there! And right over there is where we got chased by bees.
french: J'ai beaucoup de souvenirs sur cette route. Errol et moi, nous faisions souvent la course juste là ! Ah, et c'est là que des abeilles nous ont poursuivis.
russian: С этой дорогой связано много воспоминаний. Мы с Эрролом тут устраивали гонки! А вот там нас пчёлы гоняли!
bulgarian: Lot of memories on this road. Errol and I used to race just over there! And right over there is where we got chased by bees.

english: This dreary weather is the perfect ingredient!
french: Il faut dire que ce temps de chien est propice à la dégustation.
russian: Такая унылая погода — идеальная специя!
bulgarian: This dreary weather is the perfect ingredient!

english: Soup's especially good today, [Ari].
french: La soupe est vraiment délicieuse aujourd'hui, [Ari].
russian: Сегодня суп особенно хорош, [Ari].
bulgarian: Soup's especially good today, [Ari].

english: Hey there! Looking for anything in particular? Just say the word!
french: Bien le bonjour ! Tu cherches quelque chose en particulier ? Je suis là pour ça !
russian: Привет! Что-то конкретное ищешь? Просто скажи!
bulgarian: Hey there! Looking for anything in particular? Just say the word!

english: Just kidding. How can I help you?
french: Non, je rigole. Je peux t'aider ?
russian: Шучу, конечно. Чем помочь?
bulgarian: Just kidding. How can I help you?

english: In my day, you had to man the counter, saw the wood, and walk uphill in the snow all at the same time!
french: De mon temps, une seule personne devait s'occuper de la caisse, scier le bois et grimper dans les collines sous la neige !
russian: В мои годы сам и за прилавком стоял, и доски пилил, и по сугробам бегал вверх по склону — и всё одновременно!
bulgarian: In my day, you had to man the counter, saw the wood, and walk uphill in the snow all at the same time!

english: Hey now, it's [Ari]! Thanks for making the trip out here, and let me know if there's anything I can do for you.
french: Tiens, mais c'est [Ari] ! Merci d'avoir fait tout le chemin jusqu'ici. Fais-moi signe si je peux t'aider.
russian:
Ого, да это же [Ari]! Спасибо, что

заглянули

заглянулазаглянулзаглянуло. Если что — обращайся.
bulgarian: Hey now, it's [Ari]! Thanks for making the trip out here, and let me know if there's anything I can do for you.

english: No matter what Reina makes at the Inn, it's always a delight! Jo and Hemlock have a good kid there.
french: Peu importe ce que prépare Reina, c'est toujours un régal ! Jo et Hemlock ont de la chance d'avoir une fille comme elle.
russian: Что бы Рейна ни готовила в трактире — всегда вкусно! У Джо и Хемлока славный ребёнок.
bulgarian: No matter what Reina makes at the Inn, it's always a delight! Jo and Hemlock have a good kid there.

english: The good work never ends, [Ari]!
french: Il y a toujours plein de choses à faire, [Ari] !
russian: Хорошая работа никогда не заканчивается, [Ari]!
bulgarian: The good work never ends, [Ari]!

english: Sometimes retirement feels a lot like the days of my youth.
french: La retraite n'est pas sans me rappeler ma jeunesse.
russian: Иногда пенсия напоминает мне молодость.
bulgarian: Sometimes retirement feels a lot like the days of my youth.

english: It ain't easy being retired! Why, I'm busier than ever!
french: La retraite, ce n'est pas de tout repos ! Je suis plus occupé que jamais.
russian: Не так-то просто быть на пенсии! Я теперь занят больше, чем раньше!
bulgarian: It ain't easy being retired! Why, I'm busier than ever!

english: Doing a little shopping? We've got everything you could want! We can even do farm improvements for you!
french: Tu fais quelques emplettes ? Nous avons tout ce dont tu as besoin. Nous proposons même des aménagements pour améliorer ta ferme !
russian:
Покупки

затеяли

затеялазатеялзатеяло? У нас всё есть! И ферму поможем улучшить!
bulgarian: Doing a little shopping? We've got everything you could want! We can even do farm improvements for you!

english: Got to hand it to my nephew, his cooking's gotten good!
french: Je dois reconnaître que mon neveu s'est amélioré en cuisine !
russian: Надо отдать должное племяннику: готовить он научился!
bulgarian: Got to hand it to my nephew, his cooking's gotten good!

english: Everyone's going to know Ryis' name one day, I know it.
french: Un jour, le nom de Ryis sera connu de tous.
russian: Имя Риза скоро все узнают, вот увидишь.
bulgarian: Everyone's going to know Ryis' name one day, I know it.

english: I was a little worried about Ryis when he came out here from the Capital, but he went ahead and made some great friends out here. Yourself included, [Ari].
french: J'étais un peu inquiet quand Ryis a quitté la capitale pour s'installer ici, mais il a trouvé sa place et s'est fait de très bons amis. À commencer par toi, [Ari].
russian: Я немного переживал за Риза, когда он переехал из столицы, но он тут отличных друзей завёл. И ты в их числе, [Ari].
bulgarian: I was a little worried about Ryis when he came out here from the Capital, but he went ahead and made some great friends out here. Yourself included, [Ari].

english: Well well well.
french: Voilà, voilà...
russian: Так-так-так.
bulgarian: Well well well.

english: Well well well well well.
french: Voilà, voilà, voilà...
russian: Так-так-так-так-так...
bulgarian: Well well well well well.

english: I kid! Good on both of you.
french: Je plaisante ! Je suis ravi pour vous deux.
russian: Шучу-шучу! Я рад за вас обоих.
bulgarian: I kid! Good on both of you.

english: And if you need a man on the inside for when you're trying to surprise Ryis... I'm your guy!
french: Et si tu as besoin d'un informateur quand tu veux faire une surprise à Ryis... je suis ton homme !
russian: И если захочешь подготовить для Риза сюрприз... Ты знаешь, к кому обращаться!
bulgarian: And if you need a man on the inside for when you're trying to surprise Ryis... I'm your guy!

english: You and Ryis, eh?
french: Ryis et toi, hein ?
russian: Значит, вы с Ризом вместе?
bulgarian: You and Ryis, eh?

english: Have you seen the shark tooth necklace Terithia wears? I'd like to hear the tale behind that one!
french: Tu as remarqué la dent de requin que Terithia porte autour du cou ? J'aimerais bien connaître l'histoire de ce collier.
russian:
Ты

видели

виделавиделвидело ожерелье из акульего зуба у Теризии? Интересно, какая с ним связана история!
bulgarian: Have you seen the shark tooth necklace Terithia wears? I'd like to hear the tale behind that one!

english: Juniper's got a sharp tongue, but she opened the bathouse here, so she's okay in my book!
french: Juniper est une langue de vipère, mais elle a rouvert les bains, alors je ne lui en tiens pas rigueur.
russian: У Джунипер язык острый, но она открыла здесь купальню, так что в моём списке она на хорошем счету!
bulgarian: Juniper's got a sharp tongue, but she opened the bathouse here, so she's okay in my book!

english: Shop's clean, gonna treat myself to a drink!
french: L'atelier est propre, j'ai bien mérité un petit remontant.
russian: Магазин прибрал — можно и по стаканчику!
bulgarian: Shop's clean, gonna treat myself to a drink!

english: Cheers, [Ari]! Here's to rainy days, spent shoulder-to-shoulder with friends!
french: À ta santé, [Ari] ! Les jours de pluie, il faut être entouré de tous ses amis.
russian: За тебя, [Ari]! За дождливые дни в хорошей компании!
bulgarian: Cheers, [Ari]! Here's to rainy days, spent shoulder-to-shoulder with friends!

english: I never had time to sit when I was younger. It's nice to relax and watch the day go by.
french: Plus jeune, j'avais à peine le temps de me reposer. Maintenant, je peux enfin me détendre et profiter du temps qui passe.
russian: В молодости мне было не до отдыха. А теперь приятно посидеть и просто посмотреть, как течёт день.
bulgarian: I never had time to sit when I was younger. It's nice to relax and watch the day go by.

english: [Ari], it's Sunday! Gonna stretch my legs and take a stroll through town.
french: Nous sommes dimanche, [Ari] ! Je vais faire un petit tour en ville pour me dégourdir les jambes.
russian: [Ari], воскресенье ведь! Пойду прогуляюсь по городу, ноги разомну.
bulgarian: [Ari], it's Sunday! Gonna stretch my legs and take a stroll through town.

english: Sunny days are a little sweeter in retirement.
french: Quand on est à la retraite, on apprécie d'autant plus les jours de beau temps.
russian: На пенсии солнечные дни особенно хороши.
bulgarian: Sunny days are a little sweeter in retirement.

english: Let Ryis know about any projects you've got in mind! Don't be shy, now.
french: Si tu as des projets à réaliser, parles-en à Ryis. Ne sois pas timide.
russian: Если будут какие-то проекты — скажи Ризу! Не стесняйся.
bulgarian: Let Ryis know about any projects you've got in mind! Don't be shy, now.

english: Terithia's stories are a real thrill. She was out seeing the world while I was at home hammering nails!
french: Terithia a des tas d'histoires passionnantes. Pendant que moi, je plantais des clous dans mon atelier, elle parcourait le monde entier !
russian: Истории Теризии — ух, дух захватывает. Пока она мир видела, я тут гвозди забивал!
bulgarian: Terithia's stories are a real thrill. She was out seeing the world while I was at home hammering nails!

english: A tidy shop is good for business!
french: Un atelier bien tenu attire le chaland !
russian: Чистота в магазине — залог успеха!
bulgarian: A tidy shop is good for business!

english: The town sure is lively today! You're no exception, [Ari]!
french: La ville déborde d'activité aujourd'hui ! Et ça vaut pour toi aussi, [Ari] !
russian: Город сегодня прямо полон жизни! Да и ты не отстаёшь, [Ari]!
bulgarian: The town sure is lively today! You're no exception, [Ari]!

english: General Store got lots of nice veggies in! I'm gonna load up! That nephew of mine loves a =Veggie Sub Sandwich=.
french: Le magasin général a reçu beaucoup de légumes ! Je vais faire des réserves. Mon neveu adore les =sandwichs aux légumes=.
russian: В лавке отличные овощи! Надо закупиться! Мой племянник обожает =овощной сэндвич=.
bulgarian: General Store got lots of nice veggies in! I'm gonna load up! That nephew of mine loves a =Veggie Sub Sandwich=.

english: Wait, that's not quite right...
french: Non, attends. Je dis n'importe quoi...
russian: Хотя... подожди, что-то тут не так...
bulgarian: Wait, that's not quite right...

english: If you have any questions about Mistria, I'm your guy! Been living here my whole life, and then some!
french: Si tu as des questions sur Mistria, je suis ton homme. J'ai quand même passé toute ma vie ici !
russian: Если что-то хочешь узнать о Мистрии — обращайся! Всю жизнь тут живу и даже дольше!
bulgarian: If you have any questions about Mistria, I'm your guy! Been living here my whole life, and then some!

english: My nephew Ryis also moved here pretty recently.
french: Mon neveu Ryis s'est installé ici il y a peu, lui aussi.
russian: Мой племянник Риз тоже недавно сюда переехал.
bulgarian: My nephew Ryis also moved here pretty recently.

english: I bet you two would get along.
french: Je suis sûr que vous pourriez vous entendre comme larrons en foire.
russian: Уверен, вы бы нашли общий язык!
bulgarian: I bet you two would get along.

english: Have you made any friends yet?
french: Est-ce que tu t'es fait des amis ?
russian:
Уже

завели

завелазавёлзавело друзей?
bulgarian: Have you made any friends yet?

english: Couldn't have asked for a better apprentice.
french: Je n'aurais pas pu rêver meilleur apprenti.
russian: Лучше подмастерья и не придумать.
bulgarian: Couldn't have asked for a better apprentice.

english: Between you and me though, I think he still misses the Capital.
french: Mais entre nous, je crois que la capitale lui manque encore.
russian: Скажу по секрету: по-моему, он до сих пор иногда скучает по столице.
bulgarian: Between you and me though, I think he still misses the Capital.

english: But I'm not too worried...
french: Mais je ne suis pas inquiet pour autant...
russian: Но я не очень беспокоюсь...
bulgarian: But I'm not too worried...

english: He's sure to put down his roots, in his own time.
french: Il finira par avoir ses racines ici.
russian: Со временем он обязательно пустит корни.
bulgarian: He's sure to put down his roots, in his own time.

english: I'm lucky that Ryis came here to Mistria.
french: J'ai de la chance que Ryis soit venu vivre à Mistria.
russian: Мне повезло, что Риз приехал в Мистрию.
bulgarian: I'm lucky that Ryis came here to Mistria.

english: Don't mind if I do!
french: Il n'y a que ça de vrai !
russian: А почему бы и нет!
bulgarian: Don't mind if I do!

english: A hot bath? In the middle of winter?
french: Un bain chaud en plein hiver ?
russian: Горячая ванна? Прямо посреди зимы?
bulgarian: A hot bath? In the middle of winter?

english: Heh, Holt taught me that one.
french: Oui, elle est de Holt, celle-là.
russian: Хех, это Хольт меня научил.
bulgarian: Heh, Holt taught me that one.

english: If woodworking's what you need, then we wood love to work with you!
french: Si tu as des travaux de menuiserie à faire, appelle-nous. Le bouleau ne nous fait pas peur.
russian: Нужна работа по дереву? В этом мы мастера, дуб даю!
bulgarian: If woodworking's what you need, then we wood love to work with you!

english: We're here for all your woodworking needs! Just say the word.
french: Nous sommes là pour tous tes travaux en menuiserie ! N'hésite pas à passer nous voir.
russian: Все столярные работы — к нам! Только скажи!
bulgarian: We're here for all your woodworking needs! Just say the word.

english: Don't mind if I do! Thanks, pal!
french: Ça me touche vraiment. Merci beaucoup !
russian:
Не откажусь! Спасибо,

дружище

подругадружищедружище!
bulgarian: Don't mind if I do! Thanks, pal!

english: A birthday gift? For me?
french: Un cadeau d'anniversaire ? Pour moi ?
russian: Подарок на день рождения? Мне?
bulgarian: A birthday gift? For me?

english: Are you sure you didn't intend this for someone else? Oh... I see...
french: Ce cadeau m'était vraiment destiné ? Ah... Bien...
russian: Это точно не для кого-то другого? Ох... ну ладно...
bulgarian: Are you sure you didn't intend this for someone else? Oh... I see...

english: Well now, I do like a nice gift! Thanks, buddy!
french: Ah, j'adore recevoir de jolis cadeaux ! Merci beaucoup !
russian:
Что ж я люблю хорошие подарки! Спасибо,

приятели

приятельницаприятельприятель!
bulgarian: Well now, I do like a nice gift! Thanks, buddy!

english: But since you already did... thanks!
french: Mais comme c'est fait... merci !
russian:
Но раз уж

постарались

постараласьпостаралсяпостаралось... спасибо!
bulgarian: But since you already did... thanks!

english: [Ari], you didn't have to go all out of your way!
french: [Ari], il ne fallait pas te donner la peine !
russian: [Ari], тебе не стоило так стараться!
bulgarian: [Ari], you didn't have to go all out of your way!

english: Thank you, [Ari]! I'm gonna make a little snack out of this later.
french: Merci, [Ari] ! Je me préparerai un petit encas avec, plus tard.
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]! Попозже как раз этим и перекушу.
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari]! I'm gonna make a little snack out of this later.

english: This is real helpful. Basic materials like this are always needed for repairs!
french: Ça va bien me servir. On n'a jamais trop de matériaux de base pour les réparations !
russian: А вот это и правда полезный подарок. Простые материалы всегда пригодятся для ремонта!
bulgarian: This is real helpful. Basic materials like this are always needed for repairs!

english: Now this is what I'm talking about! I love it, [Ari]!
french: Tu n'aurais pas pu mieux tomber ! J'adore, [Ari] !
russian: Вот это по мне! Обожаю такое, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Now this is what I'm talking about! I love it, [Ari]!

english: Ain't that something! This is just what I like to see! Thank you, [Ari]!
french: Ça alors ! Tu as mis en plein dans le mille ! Merci, [Ari] !
russian: Ну надо же! Вот это я понимаю! Спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Ain't that something! This is just what I like to see! Thank you, [Ari]!

english: Ooh [Ari], thank you! I'm going to turn this into something that turns heads!
french: Oh, [Ari], merci ! Je vais en faire quelque chose de magnifique !
russian: О-о, [Ari], спасибо! Сделаю из этого что-нибудь эффектное!
bulgarian: Ooh [Ari], thank you! I'm going to turn this into something that turns heads!

english: You can't be around as long as I have and not appreciate quality like this! Look at that luster! That shine! Thank you, [Ari]!
french: Comme j'ai pas mal de métier, je ne peux qu'apprécier cette qualité. Quelle splendeur ! Cet éclat ! Merci, [Ari] !
russian: Если столько прожить, как я, начинаешь ценить качество! Только посмотри, как блестит! Спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: You can't be around as long as I have and not appreciate quality like this! Look at that luster! That shine! Thank you, [Ari]!

english: Thanks!
french: Merci !
russian: Спасибо!
bulgarian: Thanks!

english: A $Roly Poly$? Errol used to give me those when we were kids! I didn't like it then, and I don't like it now!
french: Un $cloporte$ ? Errol m'en offrait quand on était enfants ! Je n'aimais pas ça et ça n'a pas changé !
russian: $Мокрица$? Эррол дарил мне их в детстве! Они мне тогда не нравились — не нравится и сейчас!
bulgarian: A $Roly Poly$? Errol used to give me those when we were kids! I didn't like it then, and I don't like it now!

english: Errol's really into the fancy stuff, but I'm partial to Darcy's dark roast with a bit of cream. It's a nice start to my Saturday.
french: Errol aime les boissons élaborées. Moi, j'ai un faible pour le café de Darcy avec un soupçon de crème liquide. Rien de tel pour démarrer le samedi.
russian: Эррол любит всякое с выкрутасами, а я предпочитаю простую тёмную обжарку от Дарси с каплей сливок. Отличное начало субботы.
bulgarian: Errol's really into the fancy stuff, but I'm partial to Darcy's dark roast with a bit of cream. It's a nice start to my Saturday.

english: I used to start every morning with burnt coffee and a hammer, before I retired. Turned out I was burning the beans when I roasted them. So glad Ryis figured it out!
french: Quand je travaillais, ma journée démarrait avec un café brûlé. C'est Ryis qui, plus tard, m'a expliqué que je torréfiais les grains trop fort.
russian: Раньше я начинал утро с подгорелого кофе и с молотком в руках. Потом выяснилось: это я зерно сжигал. Рад, что Риз это понял!
bulgarian: I used to start every morning with burnt coffee and a hammer, before I retired. Turned out I was burning the beans when I roasted them. So glad Ryis figured it out!

english: I used to burn my coffee every morning, so I got a taste for it... Darcy won't burn it for me, though. Fair enough.
french: Mon café avait un drôle de goût, mais je m'y étais fait... Darcy refuse de griller son café pour moi, mais c'est compréhensible.
russian: Я раньше каждое утро кофейные зерна сжигал, так и привык... а Дарси не хочет их для меня жечь. Ну, справедливо.
bulgarian: I used to burn my coffee every morning, so I got a taste for it... Darcy won't burn it for me, though. Fair enough.

english: Ryis is all about Darcy's iced coffee... Ice? In coffee? Must be a Capital thing...
french: Ryis adore le café glacé de Darcy... Des glaçons dans du café ? Encore un truc de la capitale...
russian: Риз обожает холодный кофе от Дарси... Лёд в кофе? Должно быть, столичная замашка...
bulgarian: Ryis is all about Darcy's iced coffee... Ice? In coffee? Must be a Capital thing...

english: It's a rule of thumb that a shirt's gotta have a good collar... old Louis understands that.
french: Une chemise se doit d'avoir un col amidonné... Notre Louis en est bien conscient.
russian: Главное в рубашке — правильный воротник... а Луи это понимает.
bulgarian: It's a rule of thumb that a shirt's gotta have a good collar... old Louis understands that.

english: Louis always tells me I should dress like I'm retired, even if I won't put down the hammer. These easy breezy clothes do put a little spring in my step...
french: Louis dit que je devrais m'habiller comme un retraité, même si je n'ai pas vraiment arrêté. Ces vêtements sont tellement agréables à porter...
russian: Луи всё твердит, что надо одеваться, как будто на пенсии, даже если молоток не отпускаешь. Лёгкая одежда правда бодрит...
bulgarian: Louis always tells me I should dress like I'm retired, even if I won't put down the hammer. These easy breezy clothes do put a little spring in my step...

english: Louis tells me Ryis came by earlier... I'd like to think Ryis got some of his style from his ol' Uncle...
french: Louis m'a dit que Ryis est passé un peu plus tôt... Il tient sûrement sa classe naturelle de son vieil oncle...
russian: Луи сказал, что Риз заходил утром... хочется верить, стиль он перенял от своего старика-дяди...
bulgarian: Louis tells me Ryis came by earlier... I'd like to think Ryis got some of his style from his ol' Uncle...

english: Purple and pink clothes are for everyone, [Ari]! Louis will tell you himself.
french: Le rose et le violet, ça va à tout le monde, [Ari] ! Louis te le confirmera.
russian: Фиолетовая и розовая одежда — для всех, [Ari]! Луи сам тебе скажет.
bulgarian: Purple and pink clothes are for everyone, [Ari]! Louis will tell you himself.

english: Merri's always stopping by the woodshop to ask about this and that... I don't mind it. Always happy to talk shop!
french: Merri fait toujours un arrêt à l'atelier pour poser des questions... Ça ne me dérange pas. J'adore parler boutique !
russian: Мэрри часто заглядывает в мастерскую: то спросит, то уточнит... я не против. Люблю поговорить о дереве!
bulgarian: Merri's always stopping by the woodshop to ask about this and that... I don't mind it. Always happy to talk shop!

english: It's like I always tell Merri... you have to be careful picking your varnish. A good varnish completely changes the feel of the wood!
french: Je le dis toujours à Merri... il ne faut jamais choisir un vernis à la légère. Un bon vernis change complètement le grain du bois !
russian: Я всегда твержу Мэрри: лак надо выбирать осторожно. Хороший лак полностью меняет восприятие древесины!
bulgarian: It's like I always tell Merri... you have to be careful picking your varnish. A good varnish completely changes the feel of the wood!

english: Ryis thinks I don't know that he got that bookshelf from Merri... I don't mind.
french: Ryis croit que je ne sais pas que cette bibliothèque vient chez Merri. Ce n'est pas grave.
russian: Риз думает, я не знаю, что он взял ту книжную полку у Мэрри... Да пусть.
bulgarian: Ryis thinks I don't know that he got that bookshelf from Merri... I don't mind.

english: It's a reminder that I've got to keep on my toes if I'm going to be the best furniture maker in Mistria... er, best RETIRED furniture maker. Haha!
french: Ça me rappelle seulement que je dois persévérer si je veux être le meilleur menuisier de Mistria... Enfin, menuisier à la RETRAITE. Ha ha !
russian: Напоминает мне, что нужно держать форму, если я хочу быть лучшим мебельщиком в Мистрии... ну, лучшим НА ПЕНСИИ, хаха!
bulgarian: It's a reminder that I've got to keep on my toes if I'm going to be the best furniture maker in Mistria... er, best RETIRED furniture maker. Haha!

english: This dresser Merri's got for sale looks awfully familiar... almost like one I made, back in the day. But this one's marked as vintage... couldn't be mine! ... Right?
french: Le buffet que vend Merri me dit quelque chose... On dirait un meuble que j'avais fabriqué à l'époque. Mais c'est écrit « vintage ». C'est pas le mien alors ! Pas vrai ?
russian: Комод у Мэрри на продаже выглядит подозрительно знакомо... почти как тот, что я делал. Но этот помечен как винтаж... Тогда он не может быть моей работы... Ведь так?
bulgarian: This dresser Merri's got for sale looks awfully familiar... almost like one I made, back in the day. But this one's marked as vintage... couldn't be mine! ... Right?

english: Stillwell's giving out these love fortunes, have you heard? Might try it out myself...
bulgarian: Stillwell's giving out these love fortunes, have you heard? Might try it out myself...

english: What does Stillwell mean when he says "The middle of the process is no time to determine the outcome"? I asked about love, not building a bookshelf...
bulgarian: What does Stillwell mean when he says "The middle of the process is no time to determine the outcome"? I asked about love, not building a bookshelf...

english: "Love is the adventure that awaits you." That Stillwell... he sure does know how to get a fella excited!
bulgarian: "Love is the adventure that awaits you." That Stillwell... he sure does know how to get a fella excited!

english: Stillwell told me "The waltz of love comes in twos and threes..." Is that a musical reference? I can't read sheet music!
bulgarian: Stillwell told me "The waltz of love comes in twos and threes..." Is that a musical reference? I can't read sheet music!

english: That fella is sour as a lemon and you can't even make him into a good salad dressing!
french: Ce type est tellement désobligeant qu'il me couperait presque l'appétit !
russian: Этот парень кислый как лимон, только его даже в салат не выжмешь!
bulgarian: That fella is sour as a lemon and you can't even make him into a good salad dressing!

english: Meeting Taliferro really makes you appreciate our local nobility, doesn't it?
french: À côtoyer Taliferro, on n'en apprécie que plus l'aristocratie locale, pas vrai ?
russian: Когда встречаешь Талиферро, начинаешь ценить наших местных дворян.
bulgarian: Meeting Taliferro really makes you appreciate our local nobility, doesn't it?

english: And he's not! He's getting everyone else to cook!
french: Mais ce n'est pas lui qui cuisine ! Il fait travailler les autres !
russian: Ничего! Но поручает готовить всем остальным!
bulgarian: And he's not! He's getting everyone else to cook!

english: That's a pretty good racket, if I do say so myself.
french: C'est une belle arnaque, si tu veux mon avis.
russian: Неплохую схему придумал, я должен сказать.
bulgarian: That's a pretty good racket, if I do say so myself.

english: I wanted to visit Taliferro's booth to see what the chef was cooking...
french: Je compte me rendre au stand de Taliferro pour voir ce qu'il préparait...
russian: Я хотел зайти в лавку Талиферро, посмотреть, что он готовит...
bulgarian: I wanted to visit Taliferro's booth to see what the chef was cooking...

english: Taliferro complimented my hair... I'll give it to him. He's got an eye for the finer things.
french: Taliferro m'a complimenté sur mes cheveux... Je dois lui reconnaître ça, il a l'œil pour les belles choses.
russian: Талиферро сделал комплимент моей причёске... Вынужден признать: вкус у него отменный.
bulgarian: Taliferro complimented my hair... I'll give it to him. He's got an eye for the finer things.

english: Public opinion of Taliferro ain't really fit for consumption!
french: Les gens n'apprécient pas du tout Taliferro !
russian: То, что народ думает о Талиферро, — совершенно не годно к употреблению!
bulgarian: Public opinion of Taliferro ain't really fit for consumption!

english: I keep an ear out, and let me tell you...
french: J'écoute ce qui se dit, et tu sais quoi ?
russian: Я держу ухо востро, и знаешь, что я тебе скажу...
bulgarian: I keep an ear out, and let me tell you...

english: Well, I guess it was pretty vibrant...
french: En revanche, on ne passait pas inaperçu...
russian: Ну, он был, конечно, ярковат...
bulgarian: Well, I guess it was pretty vibrant...

english: Back in my day, when we dyed our hair, we had one shade of red, and we liked it!
french: À mon époque, quand on se teignait les cheveux, il n'y avait qu'une nuance de rouge et ça nous plaisait bien !
russian: В мои времена, если мы красили волосы, то был всего один оттенок красного — и нам этого хватало!
bulgarian: Back in my day, when we dyed our hair, we had one shade of red, and we liked it!

english: Vera gives me and Ryis a 2-for-1 discount, on the days we can make it out here together. She's a good one!
french: Vera nous fait deux pour le prix d'un, à Ryis et moi, quand on arrive à se caler un rendez-vous ensemble. Elle est sympa !
russian: Вера даёт мне и Ризу скидку «два по цене одного», когда мы вместе приходим. Хорошая она!
bulgarian: Vera gives me and Ryis a 2-for-1 discount, on the days we can make it out here together. She's a good one!

english: My nephew Ryis was talking about dyeing his hair blue... might be a good look on him, come to think of it.
french: Ryis, mon neveu, a envie de se teindre les cheveux en bleu... En y réfléchissant, ça lui irait bien.
russian: Мой племянник Риз говорил, что подумывает покраситься в синий... если подумать, может, ему бы и пошло.
bulgarian: My nephew Ryis was talking about dyeing his hair blue... might be a good look on him, come to think of it.

english: Vera says she'll dye my hair to get the white out, and I might take her up on it!
french: Vera a dit qu'elle me fera une coloration pour masquer mes cheveux blancs. Je vais peut-être me laisser tenter !
russian: Вера предлагает закрасить мою седину... может, и соглашусь!
bulgarian: Vera says she'll dye my hair to get the white out, and I might take her up on it!

english: Don't suppose they work on tools, too? Imagine powering up a lathe... or a hand-plane...
french: Tu crois que ça marche sur les outils aussi ? Tu imagines si ça pouvait améliorer un tour à bois... ou un rabot...
russian: Как думаешь: на инструментах, небось, не работает? Вот бы усилить токарный станок... или, например, рубанок...
bulgarian: Don't suppose they work on tools, too? Imagine powering up a lathe... or a hand-plane...

english: That Wheedle was saying his $Snake Oil$ makes weapons more effective!
french: Wheedle dit que son $huile de couleuvre$ rend les armes plus efficaces !
russian: Хлюст недавно сказал, что его $змеиное масло$ делает оружие эффективнее!
bulgarian: That Wheedle was saying his $Snake Oil$ makes weapons more effective!

english: But it's sure got personality!
french: Mais il n'a pas d'équivalent !
russian: Но он точно индивидуальный!
bulgarian: But it's sure got personality!

english: I can't say that Wheedle's style has style...
french: Je n'irais pas jusqu'à dire que le style de Wheedle me plaît...
russian: Не скажу, что стиль у Хлюста какой-то особенно стильный...
bulgarian: I can't say that Wheedle's style has style...

english: Just don't tell Ryis, alright?
french: Mais ne dis rien à Ryis, d'accord ?
russian: Только Ризу не говори, ладно?
bulgarian: Just don't tell Ryis, alright?

english: Wheedle's $Fast Food$ sure looks tempting, doesn't it? Imagine, zooming through work AND having a tasty snack!
french: L'$encas sur le pouce$ de Wheedle donne envie, pas vrai ? Tu imagines, travailler plus vite tout en se régalant !
russian: $Фастфуд$ Хлюста выглядит весьма соблазнительно. Только представь: в момент управишься с делами И СРАЗУ вкусно поешь!
bulgarian: Wheedle's $Fast Food$ sure looks tempting, doesn't it? Imagine, zooming through work AND having a tasty snack!

english: Why yes, I DO have a good eye for a bargain! And yes, my tastes ARE exquisite! I'm glad you noticed!
french: Il a raison quand il dit que j'ai l'œil pour les bonnes affaires. Et puis, c'est vrai que j'ai très bon goût. Tu as remarqué, toi aussi.
russian: Ну да, я ПРАВДА разбираюсь в качестве! И да, у меня ПРАВДА изысканный вкус! Спасибо, что заметили!
bulgarian: Why yes, I DO have a good eye for a bargain! And yes, my tastes ARE exquisite! I'm glad you noticed!

english: There's something nice about stopping by Wheedle's booth to get buttered up a little...
french: Il y a un petit quelque chose d'agréable à s'arrêter au stand de Wheedle pour s'y faire cirer les pompes.
russian: Хорошо иногда бывает зайти к Хлюсту в лавку и послушать приятной лести...
bulgarian: There's something nice about stopping by Wheedle's booth to get buttered up a little...

english: She knew all my favorites! That's a sign of good taste.
french: Elle connaissait tous mes titres préférés ! C'est un signe de bon goût.
russian: Она знает все мои любимые песни! А это признак хорошего вкуса.
bulgarian: She knew all my favorites! That's a sign of good taste.

english: That Zorel really knows her music!
french: Cette Zorel, elle maîtrise vraiment la musique !
russian: Зорель отлично разбирается в музыке!
bulgarian: That Zorel really knows her music!

english: Don't you think he looks a bit like me, [Ari]?
french: Tu ne trouves pas qu'il me ressemble un peu, [Ari] ?
russian: Не думаешь, что он на меня похож, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Don't you think he looks a bit like me, [Ari]?

english: The other day, I was looking at that $Caldosian Emperor Bust$, over in the antiquities section of the Museum.
french: L'autre jour, je regardais le $buste d'empereur caldosien$ dans la section des antiquités du musée.
russian: На днях я смотрел на тот $бюст кальдосийского императора$ в музейном разделе антиквариата
bulgarian: The other day, I was looking at that $Caldosian Emperor Bust$, over in the antiquities section of the Museum.

english: On many a winter evening, Terithia and I would join Errol to roast up the Sweetroot he brought back from his day in the Mines. Warmed you right up!
french: Souvent, lors des soirées d'hiver, Terithia et moi, on retrouvait Errol pour faire rôtir le rhizome sucré qu'il rapportait après sa journée à la mine. Ça nous réchauffait tout de suite !
russian: Зимой мы с Теризией частенько приходили к Эрролу — он приносил сладкий корень из шахт, и мы его жарили. Сразу согревало!
bulgarian: On many a winter evening, Terithia and I would join Errol to roast up the Sweetroot he brought back from his day in the Mines. Warmed you right up!

english: That $Sweetroot$ in the Museum's collection took me back!
french: Ce $rhizome sucré$, dans les collections du musée, m'a rappelé des souvenirs !
russian: Этот $сладкий корень$ из музейной коллекции вернул меня в прошлое!
bulgarian: That $Sweetroot$ in the Museum's collection took me back!
